audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart flattened almost everything to Skill and gave Heimerdinger Level 1 and 2+ items, directly contradicting the page's own whys — whys[0] calls Level 1 'a true coin-flip', whys[2]/[3] say Voli cannot enter the nest at all, whys[4] says his 6 flips the lane, and whys[6] says 'he out-scales me hard'.
audit.why: Heimerdinger is front-loaded here: two-three turrets plus the grenade own Levels 3-5, Stormbringer's turret-disable flips Level 6, and a bruiser-tank Volibear out-stats the nest at two items. The packet chart matches that shape.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Skill, Level 3 Heimerdinger, Levels 4-5 Heimerdinger, Level 6 Volibear, First item Skill, 2+ items Volibear.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly placed — turret two at 2-3, the three-turret nest plus grenade at 4-5, Volibear's Stormbringer dive at 6, and his bruiser-tank item window at 2+. Only the ability names and effects inside them were wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate mechanical errors, repeated across whys, spikes, mid, late and wants: (a) Heimerdinger's grenade is called 'CH-3X' and its whole blast described as a stun; (b) Sky Splitter is said to stun; (c) Stormbringer is said to shield him, and Thundering Smash is called a dash.
audit.why: Riot's data: the E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat, and stuns only 'anyone directly hit' while the surround is slowed. Sky Splitter (E, 16s) damages, slows, and shields Volibear if he is inside the blast — no stun. Stormbringer (R, 160/135/110s) is the leap; it grants bonus Health and disables nearby towers, and the shield belongs to E. Thundering Smash (Q, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) is a speed ramp with an auto-attack reset that stuns the first enemy he attacks, not a dash — the wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: Land CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade's direct hit on the Thundering Smash wind-up (only the direct hit stuns); expect Sky Splitter to slow you and shield him, not stun; and hold the grenade for the Stormbringer leap, which disables a turret and gives him bonus health.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer is written in first person ('I', 'my') throughout whys, early, mid and late, breaking the site's second-person coaching voice.
audit.why: Every other matchup addresses the reader directly; a first-person page reads as a different product.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to second person at equal length.

A bruiser-tank Voli with two items walks through your beams, Frenzied Maul undoes the poke and heals him, and he brawls a squishy yordle down through the buildings — Grievous Wounds is what keeps that trade honest. The nest still zones and sieges for the team, but the straight duel is his, so stay tucked near turrets for Hextech Affinity speed and never let Stormbringer catch you alone in the side lane.

notes: Three fabricated/incorrect mechanics were live on this page: the grenade named 'CH-3X' (real name CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, and only the direct hit stuns), Sky Splitter described as a stun (it slows and shields him), and Stormbringer described as the shield source (it grants bonus Health and disables towers). The same 'CH-3X' fabrication appears in heimerdinger__trundle, so a repo-wide sweep across heimerdinger's matchups is warranted. The content layer for this matchup was written in first person throughout and has been converted to second person. packet.defects also flagged zero cooldown-sequencing cues; concrete numbers (11s grenade, 12s Thundering Smash, 160s Stormbringer) are now in the text.
